调度台接合同出击: Take a contract at the Dispatch Desk
进入下一层或撤离: Go down a floor or extract
敌对单位已无力化。地面上有可回收的物资，左键点击即可拾取。: Hostile neutralised. There are salvageable supplies on the ground; left-click to pick them up.
物资已收入背包。打开背包可检查携带物品与装备；背包装满后将无法继续拾取。: Supplies stowed. Open the inventory to check what you carry and your gear; a full pack cannot take any more.
请沿道路寻找本层出口进入下一层，或在撤离点撤离、返回罗德岛。地图上可查看已探明的: Follow the roads to this floor's exit to go deeper, or extract at an extraction point and return to Rhodes Island. The map shows the areas explored so far.
基础操作确认完毕。PRTS 将持续为您提供支援，博士。: Basic operations confirmed. PRTS will continue to support you, Doctor.
敌人出手前，地面会出现攻击预警。按闪避键可以快速脱离预警区域，每次闪避消耗体力。: Before an enemy strikes, a warning appears on the ground. Press the dodge key to get clear of it quickly; each dodge costs stamina.
作业区域内有可以搜索的箱柜。靠近后按交互键打开，点击或拖动即可取出其中的物品。: There are crates and lockers to search in the area. Walk up and press the interact key to open one, then click or drag items out.
放入安全袋: Put an item in the Secure Pouch
地图上可查看本层已探明的区域，深入入口、撤离信标等标记也会显示在上面。: The map shows the explored parts of this floor, with markers for the way deeper, extraction beacons and more.
请沿道路寻找深入入口进入下一层，或在撤离信标处撤离、返回罗德岛。: Follow the roads to the way deeper to reach the next floor, or extract at an extraction beacon and return to Rhodes Island.
博士，这段墙脚有裂痕与幽光，墙后可能是一间密室。对墙体发动近战攻击即可破开；室内: Doctor, this wall has cracks and a faint glow at its base; there may be a vault behind it. Break it with melee attacks. Inside are rare supplies, and possibly guardians.
前方地面有陷阱。踩中会受到固定伤害并提高威胁值；重型陷阱触发后有短暂引信，及时闪: There is a trap on the ground ahead. Stepping on it deals fixed damage and raises the Threat; a heavy trap has a short fuse once triggered, so a quick dodge can escape it.
已发现撤离信标。进入撤离区域并停留数秒即可撤离，携带的物品将一同带回罗德岛。: Extraction beacon found. Stay inside the extraction zone for a few seconds to extract; everything you carry comes back to Rhodes Island.
这是通往下一层的入口。按交互键选择路线：路线越危险，敌人越强，收获也越丰厚。: This is the way to the next floor. Press the interact key to choose a route: the more dangerous the route, the stronger the enemies and the richer the rewards.
强化装置可以使用一次。按交互键从几件藏品中选择一件，效果持续到本次行动结束。: The Enhancement Device can be used once. Press the interact key to choose one of several relics; it lasts until the end of this operation.
诡意行商坎诺特。可以用赤金购买藏品、装备与药剂，也可以把物品卖给他；货架可以付费: Cannot, the mysterious merchant. Buy relics, gear and potions with Pure Gold, or sell items to him; his shelves can be refreshed for a fee.
这是一处势力据点。只收购该势力需要的货物，按当前价格当面成交。: This is a faction post. It buys only the goods this faction wants, face to face at the current price.
这里有一份战斗缴获。按交互键打开，从中选择一件藏品。: Battle spoils are here. Press the interact key to open them and choose a relic.
检测到头目级敌对单位，威胁较高。请留意地面的攻击预警，必要时闪避。: Boss-class hostile detected; high threat. Watch the attack warnings on the ground and dodge when needed.
精英敌人比普通敌人更强韧，击败后的物资也更好。: Elites are tougher than ordinary enemies, and leave better supplies when defeated.
萨卡兹哨兵发现博士后会发出警报，使威胁值加速上涨。建议优先将其击倒。: Once a Sarkaz Sentinel spots the Doctor it raises the alarm, and the Threat climbs faster. Take it down first.
敌人掉落了治疗球。靠近即可吸取，立即回复生命。: An enemy dropped a healing orb. Walk near to draw it in and restore HP at once.
欢迎回来，博士。PRTS 已完成同步。请先确认行动能力：左键点击地面即可前往目标: Welcome back, Doctor. PRTS is synchronised. Please confirm mobility first: left-click the ground to move there; hold the left button to keep moving.
穿上一件装备: Put on a piece of gear
可以按需调整观察视角：滚轮缩放，旋转键每次转动 45°，翻页键调整俯角，按住中键: Adjust the view as you need: scroll to zoom, the turn keys rotate 45° at a time, Page Up/Down change the angle, drag with the middle button to rotate freely, and the reset key restores the default view.
调度台已收到新的合同委托。请前往调度台按交互键，选择地区和合同，在出发准备里确认: New contracts have arrived at the Dispatch Desk. Go to the desk and press the interact key, choose a region and a contract, then confirm your operator in the final preparations to deploy.
已抵达作业区域，检测到敌对单位。左键点击敌人，干员会自动接近并攻击；按住左键可以: Operation area reached. Hostiles detected. Left-click an enemy and your operator closes in and attacks; hold the left button to keep attacking.
每名干员都有一个主动技能，冷却完毕后按技能键施放；快捷栏上的技能格会显示冷却进度: Every operator has an active skill. Press the skill key once it has cooled down; its hotbar slot shows the cooldown.
地面上的物资会显示名牌，左键点击名牌即可拾取；按住显示键列出附近全部地面物品。背: Items on the ground show a name plate; left-click the plate to pick them up. Hold the show-items key to list everything nearby. The filter buttons on the inventory title bar hide the plates of lower-quality items.
在背包里右键一件装备即可穿上，也可以拖到左侧人偶的格子上；右键已穿的装备会卸回背: Right-click gear in the inventory to put it on, or drag it onto a slot of the figure on the left; right-click worn gear to take it off. Gear whose attribute requirements you do not meet cannot be worn.
安全袋由博士随身携带，即使行动失败，袋中的物品也会保留。在背包中 Ctrl +: The Doctor carries the Secure Pouch; what is inside is kept even if the operation fails. Ctrl + left-click an item in the inventory to put it in, or press the pouch key to put in the item picked up last.
干员档案里可以查看属性，并分配升级获得的属性点和技能点。: The operator file shows your attributes; spend the attribute and skill points gained from levelling here.
本次行动获得的藏品都记录在这里，点击即可查看效果；图鉴页收录全部藏品。: Relics gained this operation are listed here; click one to see its effect. The archive page holds every relic.
合同面板显示本次合同的目标进度，以及基地各部门的订单需求。: The contract panel shows this contract's goals and the orders from the departments at base.
屏幕下方是快捷栏：闪避、技能和药剂都在这里。左键点击一个格子可以更换其中的内容；: The hotbar at the bottom holds dodge, skill and potions. Left-click a slot to change what it holds; the auto slot on the far right takes First Aid and drinks it when HP runs low.
密室里的宝箱和藏品已被封印。击败全部守卫者后才能打开，守卫者中有一名精英。: The vault's chests and relic are sealed. Defeat every guardian to open them; one of them is an elite.
检测到干员留下的踪迹。靠近后按交互键调查；同一名干员的踪迹集齐 6 条后，调度台: Traces left by an operator detected. Walk up and press the interact key to investigate; once six traces of the same operator are found, a recruitment contract appears at the Dispatch Desk.
博士，寻访目标就在前方，身边有守卫。击败守卫后按交互键与她会面；成功撤离后，她才: Doctor, the recruitment target is ahead, with guards around her. Defeat them and press the interact key to meet her; she joins Rhodes Island once you extract.
运送合同的交接点。背包或安全袋里带着这张订单的大宗货箱时，按交互键交付；报酬在结: The handover point of a delivery contract. With this order's bulk crate in your pack or pouch, press the interact key to hand it over; payment arrives at settlement.
这里有一处火堆。点燃时站在旁边寒冷会持续下降；熄灭了就按交互键，从背包里选燃料添: There is a campfire here. While it burns, standing beside it keeps lowering the Chill; when it is out, press the interact key and add fuel from your pack.
净化喷淋点仍可使用。在旁边按住交互键约 3 秒，可以降低污染，仅限一次。: This decon shower still works. Hold the interact key beside it for about 3 seconds to reduce contamination; once only.
罗德岛小队在此待命。支付赤金可以为一件装备投保，或者直接把它送回基地。小队附近威: A Rhodes Island squad is standing by. Pay Pure Gold to insure a piece of gear, or to send it straight back to base. The Threat does not rise near the squad.
博士，前方是头目的场地。头目倒下前出口闸门会保持关闭，请做好准备再进入。: Doctor, the boss's arena lies ahead. The exit gate stays shut until the boss falls; be ready before you go in.
场地里布置有干扰地雷。站在旁边按交互键布雷，敌人踏入时会被炸伤，之后一段时间受到: Interferential mines are placed in the arena. Stand beside one and press the interact key to arm it; an enemy stepping in is blasted and takes more damage for a while. Each works once.
威胁值涨满后，敌方会派出巡逻队搜捕博士。同一层里，后来的巡逻队会更强。: When the Threat fills, the enemy sends a patrol to hunt the Doctor. On the same floor, each later patrol is stronger.
博士，干员生命偏低。快捷栏上的急救剂可以立即回复；最右侧的自动格会在生命低于下限: Doctor, your operator's HP is low. First Aid on the hotbar heals at once; the auto slot on the far right drinks when HP falls below its lower limit, set in Settings. An Emergency Cardiac Shot in the pack works by itself against a killing blow.
敌对势力正在锁定博士的位置。屏幕上方的细条就是威胁值：停留越久涨得越快，涨满时会: Hostile forces are closing in on the Doctor's position. The thin bar at the top is the Threat: it keeps rising while you stay, a patrol comes hunting when it fills, and part of it carries to the next floor.
干员正在污染区中暴露。污染达到 60 时生命上限降低、自然回复减半，90 时开始: Your operator is exposed in a contaminated zone. At 60, max HP drops and natural regeneration halves; at 90, HP starts to drain. Suppressant spray, decon showers and camps all lower it.
冰原的寒冷正在累积。达到 60 时移动和体力回复变慢，90 时攻速下降并开始掉血: The tundra's Chill is building. At 60, movement and stamina regeneration slow; at 90, attack speed drops and HP drains. A burning campfire, a thermal draught or a self-heating can drive it off.
击杀家族成员会积累血债。达到 60 时家族敌人更凶狠，90 时会派出清算小队。中: Killing family members builds Blood Debt. At 60 family enemies grow fiercer; at 90 a reckoning squad is sent. A middleman's token, a sedative or paying reparations at a camp lowers it.
前进据点已确认，博士。这里没有敌人：可以在可露希尔处补给、处理污染或血债，也可以: Forward outpost confirmed, Doctor. No enemies here: resupply at Closure's, treat contamination or blood debt, or extract. Outposts you have reached can serve as starting points later.
干员倒下，罗德岛小队已接回博士。安全袋里的物品全部保留；身上和背包里没有投保的物: Your operator fell, and the Rhodes Island squad brought the Doctor back. Everything in the Secure Pouch is kept; uninsured items worn or in the pack are lost; insured gear comes back to the Receiving Area in 2 to 4 hours. The fallen operator is badly injured; treat it at the Medical Desk.
罗德岛小队找回了投保的装备，已送到仓储区的收货区货箱。保险随之用掉，需要的话请在: The Rhodes Island squad found the insured gear and delivered it to the Receiving Area. The insurance is used up; insure again at the Logistics Counter if needed.
整备台用于换装与改造。换装页可以把仓库里的装备穿上、把物品放进背包或安全袋带走；: The Loadout Bench is for changing and modifying gear. The loadout page puts on gear from the depot and packs items into the pack or pouch; the modify page reforges, calibrates and fine-tunes gear prefixes.
出发前可以在这里为装备投保。投保的装备若没能带回，罗德岛小队会在 2 到 4 小: Insure gear here before you leave. Insured gear that does not come back is returned by the Rhodes Island squad in 2 to 4 hours; the premium equals the gear's delivery price.
仓管台管理仓储部。建成仓库总控台后，可以在这里查看全部货架、搜索物品并直接带走。: The Depot Desk runs Storage. Once the depot master console is built, it shows every shelf, lets you search, and takes items straight out.
撤离带回的物资会装成货箱送到收货区。按交互键开箱，拿起物品送去对应的上架区，或者: Supplies brought back arrive as crates in the Receiving Area. Press the interact key to open one, then carry each item to its shelving zone, or put it in the Staging Area for now.
拿着物品走进同类别的地面框，按交互键即可上架。空手站进框里按交互键，可以查看这一: Carry an item into the floor frame of its category and press the interact key to shelve it. Empty-handed in the frame, the interact key shows this zone's shelves and lets you add racks.
暂存区可以临时存放物品。想带进下一份合同，就在这里把物品放进背包；加工站的产出也: The Staging Area holds items for a while. To take something on the next contract, put it in the pack from here; the Workshop's output is delivered here too.
各部门把需要的物资写成订单挂在这里。交付货架或背包里的物品完成订单，就能获得龙门: Departments post orders for what they need here. Deliver items from the shelves or the pack to fill an order and earn LMD; you can also sell items straight to Closure.
医疗前台会给出上一份合同的回收报告。倒下的干员带有重伤、生命上限降低，在这里支付: The Medical Desk gives the recovery report of the last contract. A fallen operator is badly injured with lower max HP; pay LMD here to treat it.
药房出售标准急救剂和缓释凝胶。每份合同出发时还会免费配发 3 瓶急救剂。: The pharmacy sells Standard First Aid and Slow-Release Gel. Every contract also issues 3 First Aid for free.
可露希尔的商店用赤金出售特供药剂，每小时补货。这里还可以出售赤金、换汇、贷款，以: Closure's Store sells special potions for Pure Gold, restocked hourly. Here you can also sell Pure Gold, exchange currency, take loans, and buy squad supplies that slow a region's hazards.
交易所终端可以买卖九大势力的商品，查看行情与新闻，下现货、挂单、远期和差价合约。: The Exchange terminal trades the goods of nine factions, with prices and news, spot orders, limit orders, forwards and CFDs. The Exchange must be built first.
加工站用材料和龙门币加工成品，按现实时间计时，完成后送到暂存区。: The Workshop turns materials and LMD into goods in real time; finished goods go to the Staging Area.
人事部记录各位干员的寻访进度：从发现踪迹到可以寻访、正式入职。: Personnel records each operator's recruitment, from the first trace to recruitable to joining.
沙盘上可以指挥罗德岛号航行到各地，开启医疗驻留提升当地关系，或者提交、装箱大宗订: From the sand table you sail Rhodes Island across Terra, run medical stays to improve local relations, and submit or crate bulk orders. Voyages take real time.
科研终端用龙门币和材料推进研究，按现实时间进行。研究可以带来各种长期加成，部分课: The research terminal advances research with LMD and materials, in real time. Research brings lasting bonuses; some topics need others first.
基建总控台需要先建成。之后，每个设施接入总控台，就能在这里远程查看和购买它的升级: The Construction Hub must be built first. Then each facility connected to it can be inspected and upgraded from here.
这里是尚未建成的设施。按交互键查看建造需要的龙门币和材料；没有接入总控台的设施也: This facility is not built yet. Press the interact key to see the LMD and materials it needs; facilities not connected to the hub can be upgraded on the spot.
升降梯连接舰桥大厅与二层，二层是农业部和食堂。: The lift links the Bridge Hall with Deck 2, home of Agriculture and the Canteen.
农业部的水培槽可以种植作物，按现实时间生长，成熟后不会枯萎。作物可以送到食堂烹饪: Agriculture's hydroponic trays grow crops in real time; ripe crops never wither. The Canteen cooks them.
食堂用作物烹饪补给。出发前吃一份，下一份合同中干员会获得生命、回复或攻击方面的增: The Canteen cooks crops into meals. Eat one before you leave and your operator gains HP, regeneration or attack on the next contract.
